arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS treated_asthma_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
INNER JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON de.person_id = co.person_id
WHERE de.drug_concept_id = 778784
  AND co.condition_concept_id IN (19286, 201835);
